articles.summary: Award honors foundational discoveries in optogenetics and circuit mapping These discoveries laid the foundation for a new era in neuroscience and helped inspire MapLight’s circuit-based approach to drug discovery SAN FRANCISCO and BOSTON, Oct. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MapLight Therapeutics
articles.title: MapLight Therapeutics Celebrates Co-Founder Dr. Karl Deisseroth on Receipt of 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for the Development of Optogenetics
